models.name: NETDEFENDER PRO 98 workstation diorama
models.notes: CRT monitor, tower, keyboard, mouse, pizza box and post-it on a desk. The screen carries the NETDEFENDER menu on an emissive map at intensity 20, so it glows without needing a light. Whole-scene asset rather than a single prop.
